title: RLHF with PPO from Scratch
summary: Train the SFT model against the reward model with PPO in plain PyTorch: generation as an RL episode, a policy with a value head and a frozen reference, a reward shaped by a per-token KL penalty, advantages, the clipped objective, and the rollout-and-update loop with the tricks that keep it stable.
objectives: Map text generation onto RL terms (state, action, episode, sparse reward) and line up actions, masks and rewards in the shifted log-prob tensors
Explain the roles of the policy, value head, frozen reference and reward model, and why the reference must be a separate frozen copy
Compute a per-token KL-shaped reward, and advantages by the repo's immediate scheme, reward-to-go and GAE, for a worked example
Evaluate PPO's clipped policy loss, value loss and total loss for a batch of tokens, and say which tokens receive a gradient
Run the rollout-and-update loop, add several PPO epochs and an adaptive KL coefficient, and read reward, KL and value-loss curves
prerequisites: The RLHF objective and PPO's clipped surrogate from [Preference Tuning](/learn/fine-tuning/preference-tuning), especially [RLHF with PPO and a KL leash](/learn/fine-tuning/preference-tuning/rlhf-ppo). The SFT model from [the SFT lesson](/learn/post-training/sft-from-scratch) and the reward model from [the reward-model lesson](/learn/post-training/reward-models). Log-probabilities and sampling settings from [Sampling](/learn/model-foundations/sampling), and AdamW with gradient clipping from [Train a Tiny GPT](/learn/model-foundations/train-a-tiny-gpt/the-training-loop).
